description: The generic thing a record is about. WHY 'Subject' and not something concrete: a real pack replaces this with its actual entity (an asset, a contract, a shipment) and picks attributes that matter for that domain (PLAN_AMENDMENTS A2/core neutrality rule in AGENTS.md forbids industry vocabulary in core code, but a pack's own entity attributes are exactly where that vocabulary belongs).

attributes.description: A free-text category label for the Subject. WHY a single generic attribute: this template keeps its entity minimal on purpose so validate:packs stays fast to read end to end; add whatever attributes your domain needs.
